evidence_classes.SOURCE_BOUND: Exact local or registered source bytes establish what was stated, not whether it is true.
evidence_classes.DIRECT_PROOF: A mathematical derivation is present in the named draft or audit and still awaits independent review unless separately recorded.
evidence_classes.COUNTEREXAMPLE: A concrete object refutes the scoped universal statement.
evidence_classes.EXECUTABLE_BOUNDED: Tests establish only their exact finite covered surface.
evidence_classes.LEAN_FRAGMENT: The pinned Lean kernel checked only the named declarations and dependencies.
evidence_classes.PRIMARY_LITERATURE: Primary literature supports standard background, not bespoke CAS/TKS semantics.
evidence_classes.MANUSCRIPT_CLAIM: The supplied OpenAI technical manuscript states the result; independent proof, novelty, and peer review remain open.
evidence_classes.NO_ADMITTED_EXPERIMENT: No qualifying empirical evidence packet exists.
